name: Body Accel Whitening Toothpaste | Advanced Niacinamide Probiotic Formula | 100ml
description:
Brighten your smile with Body Accel Whitening Toothpaste – Advanced Formula. Enriched with Niacinamide and Super Probiotics-4, this toothpaste helps whiten teeth, strengthen enamel, and promote long-lasting oral freshness. Its gentle yet effective formula works to remove stains, fight bacteria, and give you a dazzling white smile with every brush.
Key Features:
 Enriched with Niacinamide for enamel support
 Contains Super Probiotic-4 for oral balance
 Effectively whitens and removes stains
 Provides long-lasting freshness
 Gentle on teeth and gums for daily use
How to Use:
 Apply pea-sized amount on toothbrush
 Brush thoroughly twice daily
 Rinse well after brushing
Ingredients:
Niacinamide, Super Probiotic-4, Fluoride, Hydrated Silica, Glycerin, Aqua, Sorbitol, Mild Flavoring Agents
Safety Information:
 For external oral use only
 Do not swallow toothpaste
 Keep out of reach of children under 6 years
 Store in a cool, dry place
Package Includes:
 1 × Body Accel Whitening Toothpaste 100ml
